title: I made a free SWAT Kats browser game: fly the TurboKat over Megakat City
author: Ambitious-Culture872
selftext:
I’ve been building **SWAT Kats: Megakat Skies**, an unofficial, non-commercial fan game you can play in your browser on desktop or phone. I built it with Claude Code (AI), with [**swatkats.info**](http://swatkats.info) as the reference for everything. Feedback welcome!

* **Play:** [https://swatkatsfangame.com/](https://swatkatsfangame.com/)
* **Source:** [https://github.com/prateekbh/skats](https://github.com/prateekbh/skats)
* **Episode 1:** Creepling waves, then Dark Kat’s shielded jet, which you beat with Scrambler Missiles
* **Weapons:** Octopus, Buzz-Saw, Scrambler, Slicer and Match Head missiles
